title: Booking a weekend trip to Da Lat
context: A phone call between a travel agent and a customer booking a weekend trip to Da Lat.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon, Southern Travel. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi, I'd like to book a weekend trip to Da Lat for two adults. We'd like to leave on the fourteenth of March. My surname is Nguyen. That's N-G-U-Y-E-N.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. How many nights would you like to stay?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Two nights, please, so we'd come back on the Sunday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Would you prefer the train or the coach?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The train, please. We'd like a sleeping cabin if there are any left.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check. Yes, we still have two cabins on that date. Can I take a contact number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Of course. It ends in four, seven, two, nine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Before I confirm, may I ask why you're travelling? Is it for a special occasion?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's my parents' wedding anniversary, so I'd like it to feel special. We're hoping for a relaxing break in the hills.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's lovely. Breakfast is included every day at the hotel, but lunch and dinner are not.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's fine. Are there any activities in the package?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. The package includes a cable car ride and a boat trip on the lake. I'll send you the full itinerary today. Please confirm your booking by email by the tenth of March, otherwise we'll release the cabins.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you. I'll confirm as soon as I get the email.
